title: A non-musical, churchgoing family
summary: Punch says nobody in his family played and they were church members with no instruments in church.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your father play music or your uncle or anybody?
Well, no, none of them. No, none of them. Mm-hmm. They're all pretty much church members.
They didn't play anything in their church either, huh?
Not in the time, no. No, no. No, they didn't play in church like they do now, no instruments.
